## Clarify results

**5 questions asked & answered**, all integrated into `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`:

| # | Decision | Outcome |
|---|----------|---------|
| Q1 | Duplicate-URL matching | Light normalization (ignore scheme/`www.`/case/trailing slash/tracking params; keep meaningful paths & queries) |
| Q2 | Default read state | New saves are **read**; unread view is opt-in "read later" |
| Q3 | Import of an existing address | **Non-destructive merge** (union tags, earliest date, fill only empty fields) |
| Q4 | Local copy fidelity | **Full-page single self-contained file**; PDFs kept as original |
| Q5 | Tags in bookmark HTML | Common `TAGS="…"` attribute (no folder duplication) |

**Sections touched:** added a **Clarifications** section; updated User Stories 2, 5, 13; Functional Requirements FR-006, FR-013, FR-017, FR-025, FR-027, FR-029/030, FR-031; Edge Cases; Assumptions.

I also resolved three lower-impact "to be confirmed" notes with documented defaults (sort options = saved-date / title / recently-updated; Internet Archive fallback offers to request a snapshot; oversize local copies marked unavailable). **No open ambiguity markers remain.**

**Coverage summary:** Functional scope, data model, interaction/UX, edge cases, integration (import/export, Internet Archive), and terminology are now **Resolved/Clear**. Deferred to planning (not spec-level): exact local-copy size limit, and storage/hosting mechanics.

**Spec quality checklist:** 16/16 items passing.

---

The full revised spec is in `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`. Please review it. This is a large v1 — 14 user stories spanning P1–P4 — so if you'd like to trim scope for a first release (e.g., defer preserved copies or saved filters), now's the ideal moment.

- Reply **approve** and I'll proceed to the **plan** gate (`speckit-plan`).
- Or tell me what to change and I'll update the spec first.
